name: Arc carbine
description: Fire at one enemy. Each shot can miss or critically hit.

name: Synapse surge
description: Damage an enemy and stun it for 3 seconds.

name: Bloom protocol
description: Restore health to yourself and nearby allies.

name: Kinetic veil
description: Absorb incoming damage for up to 6 seconds and draw nearby enemy attention.

name: Rail lance
description: Fire a powerful shot at a distant enemy.

name: Echo collapse
description: Damage enemies within 12 m of your target.

name: Ghostline
description: Move 12 m over at least 2 seconds, then replay up to 6 seconds of your route. Cross the cyan runner to release a shockwave, recover 20 energy, and reset your dash. Another player crossing it gives 50% more power and restores both runners. Arms after 0.6 seconds.
